summary: Iteration 74 — new conversational founder-onboarding (/signup) tested end-to-end. Backend 9/9 pytest cases pass (check-email taken/available, website-intel stripe real fetch w/ payments-keywords + garbage-url returns fetched:false, adaptive 4-question interview finishes with done:true, blueprint returns key/label depts + workflows + operational_tasks + approval_rules + products + welcome_line and references the founder's actual answers, Sarvam TTS returns a real WAV (RIFF/WAVE header, ~big enough), Sarvam STT returns 200 on a real WAV fixture, /api/auth/login still works). Frontend E2E: /signup basics flow (Enter-advance + Skip-when-empty phone + team-size chip) works, email-taken guard on owner@sharma.com shows 'This email already has a workspace — sign in instead.', website manual path (Manufacturing + B2B + description + Continue) advances, interview mute toggle used first, two adaptive Claude questions received and answered (~15s each), interview-skip advances into build; BuildReveal auto-runs blueprint + register within ~20-30s and reveals build-counts (6 Departments / 8 Workflows / 12 Recurring tasks / 5 Approval rules) plus a personalized welcome_line referencing Meera, Rakesh, weaving, QC, CIF; Enter DecisionOS navigates to /brief, welcome-overlay appears and welcome-dismiss removes it and reveals the CEO Brief with the new tenant 'Iteration74 Weavers'/'Manufacturing'/Owner Meera Test. Regression: /login unchanged — 'Need a workspace? Register →' link navigates to /signup, landing (/) contains 4 signup links that navigate to /signup, and data-testid demo-login-owner logs into Sharma Textiles Pvt Ltd (Rajesh Sharma, owner) and lands on the Decision Desk with 47 tasks.
critical_code_review_comments: Personalization is real, not templated: verified blueprint text ('through Rakesh's job card, 2-week weaving, QC, CIF shipping, and your 60-day payment collections') is quoting the founder's actual interview answers — this is the core promise of the feature and it works.

Signup.js -> BuildReveal.js correctly invokes register() with the blueprint payload after Claude returns; new tenant appears in the DB (login as Meera Test after the flow would work; verified via CEO Brief tenant chip 'Iteration74 Weavers'/'Manufacturing').

Only nit: STT accepts a real WAV in the current test (200 OK, transcript may be empty), so the 'clean 503' fallback in the pytest was not exercised — that's fine, but the client-side error toast pathway in VoiceInterview (`toast.error(e.response?.data?.detail || …)`) still cannot be UI-tested from headless Chromium since mic capture is not attempted.

BasicsFlow.js: `checkEmail` swallows network errors silently ('/* network hiccup — let register validate later */'). Intentional and OK, but if backend goes down mid-signup the founder will still advance and fail at build. Consider showing a subtle warning in future.
